features.name: Celebrity Booking
features.description: Book personalized video messages, text messages, or promotional content from your favorite celebrities
features.howTo:
1. Browse or search for a celebrity
2. Click on their profile
3. Select the service type (video message, text, promotion)
4. Fill the booking form with recipient details and your message
5. Complete payment
6. Wait for delivery (usually within 24-48 hours)
features.pricing: Varies by celebrity and service type. General video messages start from ₹5000.

features.name: AI Music Generation
features.description: Create custom songs with AI-generated lyrics and music in various genres
features.howTo:
1. Go to AI Music Studio
2. Enter your song title and prompt
3. Choose genre and mood
4. Click generate
5. Wait for AI to create your song
6. Download or save to library
features.pricing: Free users get 3 generations per month. Paid plans get unlimited.

features.name: AI Greeting Cards
features.description: Generate personalized greeting cards using AI for any occasion
features.howTo:
1. Visit Greeting Cards page
2. Select or enter an occasion
3. Enter recipient name and custom prompt
4. Optionally upload reference image
5. Generate card
6. Download or share
features.pricing: ₹2 per card generation. Deducted from wallet balance.

features.name: Celebrity Occasions
features.description: Send wishes on celebrity birthdays, anniversaries and special occasions
features.howTo:
1. Go to Occasions page
2. View upcoming celebrity occasions
3. Click to send a wish or book a video message
4. Fill the form and submit
features.pricing: Free to send wishes. Video bookings have separate pricing.

features.name: Wallet System
features.description: Manage your digital wallet for quick payments and withdrawals
features.howTo:
To add funds:
1. Go to Wallet page
2. Click 'Add Funds'
3. Enter amount
4. Complete payment via Razorpay

To withdraw:
1. Add bank details in Profile
2. Request withdrawal from Wallet
3. Admin will process within 2-3 business days
features.pricing: No fees for adding funds. Withdrawal may have processing fees.

features.name: Following System
features.description: Subscribe to your favorite celebrities for exclusive content and priority booking
features.howTo:
1. Go to celebrity profile
2. Click 'Add to Favorites'
3. Complete subscription payment
4. Get access to exclusive content and benefits
features.pricing: ₹999 per celebrity subscription. Includes referral commissions.

features.name: Messaging
features.description: Direct chat with celebrities after booking their services
features.howTo:
1. Complete a booking with a celebrity
2. Go to Messages page
3. Select the conversation
4. Send and receive messages
5. Celebrity may use AI to generate replies
features.pricing: Free for users who have active bookings.

features.name: Referral Program
features.description: Earn commissions by referring users or celebrities to the platform
features.howTo:
1. Get your referral code from Profile
2. Share with friends
3. When they sign up and make bookings, you earn commission
4. Level 1 referrals: 5-10%
5. Level 2 referrals: 2-5%
features.pricing: Free to participate. Earnings deposited to wallet.

features.name: Celebrity Registration
features.description: Join as a celebrity to offer your services and earn money
features.howTo:
1. Click 'Become a Celebrity'
2. Fill registration form
3. Upload verification documents
4. Set your service prices
5. Upload consent video/photo
6. Wait for admin approval
7. Start receiving bookings
features.pricing: Free to join. Platform takes 30% commission. TDS deducted based on PAN status.

features.name: Image Promotions
features.description: Get AI-generated promotional images featuring celebrities
features.howTo:
1. Go to Image Promotions
2. Select celebrity
3. Enter brand/product concept
4. Provide branding details
5. Generate promotional image
6. Download for use

features.name: UGC Videos
features.description: Generate User Generated Content style videos with celebrity AI avatars
features.howTo:
1. Visit UGC Videos page
2. Select celebrity
3. Enter video concept
4. Generate video with AI avatar
5. Download for social media

features.name: Reviews & Ratings
features.description: Rate and review celebrities after booking completion
features.howTo:
1. Complete a booking
2. Go to Bookings page
3. Click on completed booking
4. Rate (1-5 stars) and write review
5. Submit
